question: What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19 in the second qualifying period?
evidence: race number refers to raceId; second qualifying period refers to q2; best lap time refers to MIN(q2);
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT T2.surname AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC) AS __r FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T2.surname FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19 ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC LIMIT 1

b.request: Which driver(s), including all drivers tied for the minimum q2 time, had the best (lowest) second-qualifying-period (q2) lap time in raceId 19, and what is their surname?
b.sql: SELECT d.driverId, d.surname FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 19 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 <> '' AND q.q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = 19 AND q2 IS NOT NULL AND q2 <> '')

c.sql: SELECT d.surname FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 19 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 <> '' AND q.q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = 19 AND q2 IS NOT NULL AND q2 <> '')

d.request: ** What is the surname of the driver (or drivers, if several tie) with the best lap time (MIN of q2) in the second qualifying period (q2) of race number 19 (raceId = 19)? If multiple rows tie for that best time, return all of them.
d.sql: SELECT d.surname FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 19 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 <> '' AND q.q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = 19 AND q2 IS NOT NULL AND q2 <> '')
